The remaining 23 diverge and are strict xfails: 21 reproduce F-23's depth-override defect (C++ DUF_Mngr overwrites the depth unconditionally at fof_duf.cpp:395 with f_DufDep*(f_Per/100), discarding Eqs 5/6/7/15, while Python returns the raw regression depth), measured |diff| 0.006 to 1.0791 in; 2 (ne-wph-entire-m050, se-cp-entire-m050) diverge because their percent already diverges under F-39. The 14 flaming/smoldering totals agree across both expanded scenarios (ef groups 2/5/8 and 3/7/8): measured maximum relative difference 1.89e-07, consistent with C++'s float32 d_CO storage plus six-decimal output formatting; the recorded rtol 5e-07 sits just above that. consume_p4.litter_cp: known_divergent_strict_xfail — consm_litter vs the ONE consume-mode row whose litter C++ does not route through Burnup: se-cp-entire-m050, the Coastal Plain scenario, where HSF_Mngr dispatches _CalcCP_Lit (fof_hsf.cpp:83-85, :107-127) because DUF_Mngr set i_LitEqu == e_CP_PerEq. Executed 2026-09-01 as part of closing BR-LIT-CP's EXPECT-INVESTIGATE status. C++ reports LitCon 2.000000 T/ac from a 2.000000 T/ac pre-fire load (f_PerLit 100 %); consm_litter has no Coastal Plain route at all - CVR_GRP_CODES contains no CoastPlain token - so the closest representable Python call (reg='SouthEast', the region the scenario really carries, with the unrecognised 'CoastPlain' cover group) falls into the SouthEast equation-998 branch and returns 1.600000 T/ac. Measured |diff| 0.400000 T/ac, i.e. 20 % of the pre-fire load. This is F-39's Coastal Plain routing gap on the litter side, so the whole route is a strict xfail. The recorded atol is NOT a measured agreement bound - none exists on this route - it is the golden's own output resolution (LitCon is written through fmt(v, 6)), recorded so the desired-behaviour assertion has a centrally held bound; it is 40000x smaller than the divergence and therefore absorbs none of it. (gate0/04-findings.md:F-39; gate0/07-branch-traceability.csv BR-LIT-CP; tests/unit/test_phase4_consumption_parity.py::test_consume_coastal_plain_litter_matches_cpp)

Twelve diverge and are strict xfails: 2 under F-26 (missing 0-floor, |diff| 4.9 and 18.8), 1 under F-27a (missing division by e_Adj = 1.4, |diff| 28.4), 6 under F-41 (no NorthEast/SouthEast Equ_14_MSE routing; 4 give the wrong equation with |diff| 30.96 to 69.59 and 2 return NaN outright), 2 under F-39 (no Chaparral Equ_19_MSE and no Coastal Plain route, |diff| 38.78 and 56.22) and 1 under F-40 (no zero-duff-load rule, |diff| 56.22). The smallest divergence is 4.9 percentage points, so the tolerance masks none of them. (gate0/04-findings.md:F-26, F-27a, F-39, F-40, F-41; gate0/07-branch-traceability.csv BR-MSE-9, BR-MSE-10, BR-MSE-11, BR-MSE-12, BR-MSE-13, BR-MSE-202, BR-MSE-PILE; tests/unit/test_phase4_consumption_parity.py::MSE_XFAIL)
